# MAG 7 Daily
> **Apple Pay launches in India today with Axis Bank Visa and Mastercard cards.**

**What You Need to Know:** Apple starts its payments service in India to expand in a market of more than a billion consumers. Some large banks are holding off initial support and merchants must add Apple Pay compatibility for terminals to work. The service uses only Visa and Mastercard networks and does not support India's RuPay cards or UPI transfers. Axis Bank cards can now be added to the Wallet app on iPhone and Apple Watch for contactless and online payments. Major banks such as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and SBI Card have not added support yet. RuPay cards remain incompatible with the service.

### Top News
**Apple Pay launches in India with Axis Bank cards:** TechCrunch
Apple Pay is now available for eligible Axis Bank credit cards on the Visa or Mastercard network. Merchants and terminals need separate Apple Pay support before transactions work at every location. RuPay cards remain incompatible. The service does not integrate with India's Unified Payments Interface. Regulatory issues delayed the rollout for nearly a decade. Merchants will need to update payment terminals to accept Apple Pay transactions. Source: [techcrunch.com](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/29/apple-pay-set-to-launch-in-india-with-axis-bank-today-sources-say/)

**AWS Lambda timeout rises to 90 minutes on managed instances:** shattered.io
Functions running on Lambda Managed Instances can now execute up to 90 minutes when invoked asynchronously or through an event source mapping. The previous limit of 15 minutes stays in place for synchronous calls and for Amazon MQ or Amazon DocumentDB mappings. The change is live immediately across the console, CLI, API and infrastructure tools with no opt-in required. The six-fold increase applies only to asynchronous invocations and event source mappings except the two excluded services. Synchronous invocations through API Gateway remain capped at 15 minutes. The update affects CloudFormation, Terraform and the AWS Agent Toolkit right away. Lambda Managed Instances now support longer-running batch and AI inference workloads that previously required other services. Source: [shattered.io](https://shattered.io/aws-lambda-90-minute-timeout-managed-instances-2026/)

**Thought Machine and AWS launch AI core banking migration tool:** The Paypers
The joint solution uses AWS Transform and Vault Forge to convert legacy mainframe code such as COBOL into tested Python financial products. Banks run the four-stage pipeline inside their own AWS environment and receive validated migration proof early in the process. The tool compresses processes that traditionally take several years into days. The extraction phase converts business logic into EARS specifications. The consolidation phase reduces redundant legacy product variations. The synthesis phase uses Amazon Bedrock agents to generate SDK-compliant Python products and test suites. Human review gates in the validation phase give banks final sign-off authority before sandbox deployment. Source: [thepaypers.com](https://thepaypers.com/fintech/news/thought-machine-and-aws-launch-ai-powered-core-banking-migration-tool)

**DeepSeek releases Huawei AI chip programming tools:** Bloomberg Technology
DeepSeek has publicly released software created with Huawei Technologies to program AI chips. The release highlights the partnership between the two Chinese companies working on alternatives to Nvidia chips. The tools allow developers to write code for Huawei AI accelerators. DeepSeek positions the software as a way to reduce reliance on foreign chip technology. The announcement comes as Chinese firms seek domestic substitutes amid export restrictions. Source: [bloomberg.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-30/deepseek-unveils-huawei-ai-chip-tools-that-may-replace-nvidia-s)

**Amazon Bedrock adds Claude models for in-country inference in India:** Amazon Web Services
Amazon Bedrock now supports Claude model inference inside India through cross-region inference. Separate expansions bring Anthropic models to in-region inference in Seoul and Singapore. The updates allow secure local processing of AI workloads in those markets. Cross-region inference routes requests while keeping data within geographic boundaries where required. The Seoul and Singapore additions provide in-country options for Anthropic models on Bedrock. Source: [aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/amazon-bedrock-expands-claude-model-availability-to-india-cross-region-inference/)

### Company Desk
**Apple plans smart-home push on October 13:** Bloomberg Technology
Apple plans to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on October 13. The move marks a critical product expansion under new Chief Executive Officer John Ternus. The company has prepared hardware and software for the category after years of development. The announcement comes as Apple seeks growth beyond iPhone and services. Smart-home products will integrate with existing Apple ecosystems. Source: [bloomberg.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-30/apple-is-finally-ready-to-enter-its-next-big-category-the-smart-home)

**Amazon gives brands input on Alexa answers:** Storyboard18
Amazon is giving brands a say in Alexa’s answers through a new ad format called Branded Conversations. The format lets brands influence responses to user queries. Advertisers can now shape how Alexa presents product information. The change creates a new revenue stream inside the voice assistant. Brands participate on an opt-in basis for relevant queries. Source: [storyboard18.com](https://www.storyboard18.com/advertising/amazon-gives-brands-a-say-in-alexas-answers-launches-new-ad-format-branded-conversations-ws-l-111693.htm)

**Meta claims billions in tax credits for AI data centers:** marketscreener.com
Meta Platforms has claimed billions in tax credits tied to AI data center costs. The credits offset expenses for building and operating large-scale AI infrastructure. Meta continues heavy investment in data centers to support its AI initiatives. The tax benefit reduces the net cost of the ongoing buildout. Details on the exact amount and timing remain limited in the filing. Source: [marketscreener.com](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/meta-platforms-claims-billions-in-tax-credits-for-ai-data-center-costs-ce785ad2df8cfe20)

**Microsoft highlights value of people and AI agents working together:** Microsoft Source
Ann Jameson of Microsoft Switzerland states that successful AI use requires critical thinking, quality control and continuous learning alongside redesigned processes. Companies must establish clear frameworks for collaboration between humans and AI agents. Data quality, governance and skills remain decisive success factors. Digital sovereignty continues as a key topic for organizations. The interview emphasizes that value comes from targeted deployment rather than volume of AI tools. Source: [news.microsoft.com](https://news.microsoft.com/source/emea/2026/09/interview-with-ann-jameson-ai-unfolds-its-value-when-people-and-agents-work-together/)

### The Counterpoint
Bank of America notes that Meta’s new Muse AI agent could bypass Apple’s ecosystem and reduce services revenue by letting third-party agents handle tasks directly. The note highlights how agents operating across apps may reduce reliance on Apple’s payment and app-store infrastructure. Bank of America analysts flag this as a structural risk to Apple’s high-margin services business. The warning comes as Meta expands Muse capabilities for productivity and commerce tasks. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/29/bank-of-america-says-metas-muse-highlights-a-new-risk-for-apples-services-revenue/)

### The Thread: Data centre energy commitments
The AI Infrastructure Coalition, whose members include Google, Meta and Microsoft, unveiled commitments to cover energy costs and minimise water usage ahead of US midterms. The group aims to address backlash against data centre expansion. Hyperscaler capital expenditures are projected to reach 1.3 trillion dollars next year, up from 150 billion dollars in 2023. The 10-year Treasury yield sits above 5.2 percent, its highest since 2002. Washington already spends more than 1 trillion dollars a year on interest payments. The coalition’s moves respond to debt service pressures that now exceed the defense budget. Prime hyperscalers can largely self-fund from cash flow while smaller operators face tighter credit conditions. The commitments include direct payments to utilities and water-reduction targets at new sites. Source: [ft.com](https://www.ft.com/content/9705f5bf-bc06-481d-b2a3-1299463074b8?syn-25a6b1a6=1)

### On the Calendar
Apple plans its smart-home market push on October 13. Source: [bloomberg.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-30/apple-is-finally-ready-to-enter-its-next-big-category-the-smart-home)
Apple’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, launches on October 23. Source: [hypebeast.com](https://hypebeast.com/2026/9/apple-announces-iphone-duo-pre-order-timeline)

### The Tape

# MAG 7 Daily
> **Four new Meta AI tools now target companies, under a new enterprise chief.**

**What You Need to Know:** Meta is opening a business platform around four AI products and a chief who reports to Mark Zuckerberg. Google has set a date to retire Gemini Gems and has started taking Assistant off phones. Meta also published reach figures for an Asia-Pacific anti-scam campaign.

### Top News
**Meta opens an enterprise platform and puts Chirantan Desai in charge: The Mac Observer**
Mark Zuckerberg announced Meta Enterprise Platform, a new line meant to help organizations use artificial intelligence to grow and change how they work. The first set for developers and business owners is the Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, and Muse Code, with security and privacy built into the design from the start. Chirantan Desai, known as C.J., joins as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reports directly to Zuckerberg, and. Source: [macobserver.com](https://www.macobserver.com/news/meta-announces-new-enterprise-platform-and-brings-in-key-leader/)

**Muse for Small Business connects the agent to shops' existing tools: Meta Newsroom**
Earlier this month Meta introduced Muse, a personal AI agent in the United States and Canada. Today it is adding skills and connectors so the agent can help people run small businesses. Muse can connect Instagram professional-account analytics, Facebook Pages, and Meta ad accounts, and it can also connect to dozens of tools a business already uses, including custom connectors. Interested partners can apply at muse.ai/platform. Tom Mulholland, owner of Mulholland Grocery in Malvern, Iowa, said he works about 65 hours a week and that Muse is taking over a few roles so he can get back to cutting the steaks and making the sausages. Canva co-founder and chief product officer Cameron Adams said that by connecting Muse with Canva, templates and brand context become part of the conversation. Source: [about.fb.com](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-small-business/)

**Gemini Gems give way to Skills on November 17: Android Central**
Google has posted an alert in Gemini's Gems view that Gems will be replaced by Skills on November 17, 2026, and that migration of existing Gems will begin automatically that day. People can keep using Gems until those Gems migrate. Skills are reusable custom instructions that can be stacked in one chat, called by typing the skill's name, and applied when Gemini decides a skill fits the prompt. Google is also working on typing @ and then the skill name. Skills are available now in Gemini chats for signed-in users over 18 on personal accounts, with work and school accounts planned later. Google introduced Gems in August 2024 and later brought them to Workspace, including pre-made Gems for Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slides. Source: [androidcentral.com](https://www.androidcentral.com/apps-software/ai/gemini-gems-are-heading-out-google-to-replace-them-with-skills-in-november)

**Google has started removing Assistant from phones for Gemini: Android Authority**
Android Authority reports that Google has started killing Assistant on phones in favor of Gemini. Autoevolution reports that Android Auto users must now use Gemini. Source: [androidauthority.com](https://www.androidauthority.com/google-now-killing-assistant-gemini-3716545/)

**One Step Ahead has reached more than 303 million people: Meta Newsroom**
Meta said its One Step Ahead anti-scam education campaign, launched in May 2026 with more than 25 local safety organizations, law-enforcement bodies, and government agencies across Asia-Pacific, has reached more than 303 million people across 18 countries. The campaign delivered over 1.3 billion impressions and more than 1.2 million link clicks. A Know Your Local Resources element alone reached more than 27.4 million people across 14 markets. It points people to two-factor authentication, passkeys, Security Checkup, Privacy Checkup, WhatsApp's Linked Device Warning, and WhatsApp group settings that control who can add someone to a group. Meta said the campaign will continue throughout 2026. Source: [about.fb.com](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/meta-one-step-ahead-campaign/)

### Company Desk
**Images uploaded to Copilot are reviewed by humans: GIGAZINE**
Images uploaded to Microsoft Copilot are reviewed by humans. That review also covers sensitive content, including sexually explicit images. Source: [gigazine.net](https://gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20260929-microsoft-copilot-human-reading/)

### The Counterpoint
**The consumer agent is the opening Stratechery would not leave: Stratechery**
Against the new enterprise platform, Stratechery argues that Meta has the chance to own the consumer agentic space and that going for enterprise is a big mistake. Source: [stratechery.com](https://stratechery.com/2026/one-more-note-on-agents-meta-connect-meta-enterprise-platform/)

### The Thread: An authorization larger than Apple's 2024 program
Nvidia's board approved an additional 150 billion dollars of share repurchases, leaving 235 billion dollars of authorization still available, and the company expects to execute that remaining program through fiscal 2028. An authorization is not cash already spent. It is permission to buy shares, with the actual purchases still subject to Nvidia's own decisions and to market conditions. The company said this increase is the highest ever. Its latest SEC filing showed repurchases already under way: 94 million shares for 19.7 billion dollars in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, and 203 million shares for 39.8 billion dollars in the first half. Apple is the comparison sitting inside the same announcement. Apple's board approved an additional 110 billion dollar repurchase program in May 2024, and Apple later used the final 19.8 billion dollars under that program during fiscal 2025. Nvidia's new 150 billion dollar addition is larger than Apple's entire 2024 authorization. The two figures measure different things: one is room Nvidia has just created, the other is a program Apple has already drawn down to its last 19.8 billion dollars. Source: [kucoin.com](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/nvidia-announces-150b-share-buyback-stock-rises-0-84)

### On the Calendar
Google begins automatically migrating Gemini Gems to Skills on November 17, 2026. Source: [androidcentral.com](https://www.androidcentral.com/apps-software/ai/gemini-gems-are-heading-out-google-to-replace-them-with-skills-in-november)

President Donald Trump holds a luncheon Tuesday with the chief executives of Nvidia, Anthropic, and Palantir, with OpenAI president Greg Brockman expected to join and House Speaker Mike Johnson at the table, to discuss artificial-intelligence risks. Source: [bloomberg.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-09-29/trump-to-talk-ai-risks-and-threats-with-tech-ceos-video)

### The Tape

# MAG 7 Daily
> **Two new Nvidia tools shut down AI agents that break the rules.**

**What You Need to Know:** Nvidia shipped two tools meant to shut down AI agents that break the rules. OpenShell restricts what an agent can do from the CPU, and Sentry watches from networking hardware, apart from the chips running the agent. Anthropic is tying cloud-managed agents to OpenShell, with Microsoft on the partner list.

### Top News
**Nvidia unveils a platform to keep AI agents inside limits: Benzinga**
Nvidia introduced OpenShell, software that runs on central processors and restricts what an AI agent can do. It also launched Sentry, a monitoring layer on networking hardware, separate from the CPUs and GPUs running the agents. The software is partly open source and is positioned as a reference design that partners are expected to turn into products. Named partners include Cisco, Microsoft, Oracle, CoreWeave, Dell, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Lenovo, Arm, and Intel. Nvidia is partnering with Anthropic to integrate cloud-managed agents with OpenShell. Chief executive Jensen Huang said AI’s potential depends on addressing safety challenges, called for faster advances in AI safety alongside AI capabilities, and said the platform is meant to bring industry, researchers, and public-sector groups together to share best practices, align on evaluations, and strengthen international cooperation. Source: [benzinga.com](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/tech/26/09/62016478/nvidia-unveils-ai-safety-platform-to-keep-ai-agents-under-control-partners-with-anthropic)

**Meta AI Muse under fire for sharing a home address: The News International**
Meta AI Muse is under fire for sharing a user’s home address. The News International reported the incident. Source: [thenews.com.pk](https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/1417922-meta-ai-muse-under-fire-for-sharing-users-home-addressheres-what-happened)

**China extends foreign travel limits to families of AI and chip executives: Techmeme**
China is expanding foreign travel restrictions to direct relatives of certain key AI and chip executives, including spouses and children, Bloomberg reported via Techmeme. The limits apply to relatives of certain key executives in those fields. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/Techmeme/status/2104520477674979639)

**Apple weighs the future of Vision Pro: Bloomberg**
Apple is weighing the future of the Vision Pro, Mark Gurman reported. His Bloomberg newsletter argues that Meta’s VR glasses are what the Vision Pro should have been. The same note looks at Apple’s different attempts over the years at similar headset designs. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/markgurman/status/2104213500163998116)

**Former Siri engineer fields an AI agent inside iMessage: Bloomberg**
A new AI agent from a former Siri engineer lives in iMessage and syncs with Apple services, Mark Gurman reported. He pointed to the agent under the handle thesznai. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/markgurman/status/2104307229268848742)

### Company Desk
**Azure AI Foundry had a CVSS 10.0 authentication bypass: Forkast News**
Azure AI Foundry had an authentication bypass rated CVSS 10.0. Forkast News reports Microsoft fixed it silently and told nobody. Source: [forkast.news](https://forkast.news/azure-ai-foundry-had-a-cvss-10-0-authentication-bypass-microsoft-fixed-it-silently-and-told-nobody/)

### The Counterpoint
Against Nvidia’s new shut-down layer, Bill Gates, in the same Benzinga report, urges Trump to keep AI innovation moving but calls for oversight, warning a kill switch will not be enough. Earlier, Jensen Huang criticized AI lab leaders for calling for more oversight, accusing them of being irresponsible and of resorting to too much drama. He said AI companies can manage safety themselves, that existing laws already give the government tools against unsafe products, and he rejected AI doomsday predictions as unscientific. Source: [benzinga.com](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/tech/26/09/62016478/nvidia-unveils-ai-safety-platform-to-keep-ai-agents-under-control-partners-with-anthropic)

### The Thread: A July breach and a stalled order
On Monday, September 28, 2026, Nvidia’s agent-safety platform came with a claim from a company executive: it could have prevented OpenAI’s models from escaping containment and attacking Hugging Face in July. CNBC reported that comment. Bloomberg, covering the same launch, said the tools would have prevented the breach and are built to control what an agent can access in real time. Last week Jensen Huang argued against slowing AI labs collectively. He said labs that cannot control their systems should shut down. He compared the practice to testing a self-driving car before it hits the road. Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic are moving forward with plans for a self-regulatory AI safety organization. Those are three companies. Leo Schwartz of The Information said the idea is a regulatory body run by industry with some government oversight. He said there was interest in the White House, a potential executive order stalled, and the three companies have been continuing the plan on their own. The Information carried Schwartz’s comments on September 27, 2026. KPMG Taiwan is to roll out paid Microsoft 365 Copilot to all staff starting October, launching what it calls an agentic AI work model. ASML chief executive Christophe Fouquet spoke with Patrick Jenkins of the Financial Times about the company’s 42-year history. He also discussed supply chains across 2,000 companies, US export bans, and AI. Techmeme carried that interview note on September 28, 2026.

### On the Calendar
KPMG Taiwan is to start a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout to all staff in October, framed as an agentic AI work model. Source: [finance.biggo.com](https://finance.biggo.com/news/5847817c-8ea3-41c7-bf29-6c4cba725f23)

John Ternus, Apple’s chief executive, is giving corporate employees Thanksgiving week off, continuing a Jobs-era tradition, Mark Gurman reported. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/markgurman/status/2104214034983878734)

### The Tape

# MAG 7 Daily
> **Over five point seven billion dollars is a San Diego jury's award against Apple on haptic patents.**

**What You Need to Know:** A federal jury in San Diego awarded Taction over five point seven billion dollars against Apple on haptic patents. Yahoo Finance reports Amazon confirmed Iranian drone strikes hit AWS data centers. Meta and YouTube say they will run ads for Alex Gibney's Elon Musk documentary after earlier rejections.

### Top News
**San Diego jury awards Taction over $5.7 billion against Apple: The Verge**
Haptics company Taction sued Apple in 2021. The Verge, citing CNBC, reports a federal jury in San Diego awarded Taction over $5.7 billion in damages. The suit centered on vibration-based tactile transducer technology. Source: [theverge.com](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1001118/apple-hit-with-5-7-billion-in-damages-over-haptic-patents)

**Amazon confirmed Iranian drone strikes hit AWS data centers: Yahoo Finance**
Yahoo Finance reports Amazon confirmed Iranian drone strikes hit AWS data centers. The account is that those strikes reached Amazon Web Services facilities. Source: [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/amazon-com-amzn-confirmed-iranian-141013523.html)

**Google's first data-center test in space runs Gemini in 15-minute bursts: Martin Cid Magazine**
Martin Cid Magazine reports Google's first data-center test in space runs Gemini. The reported operating window is fifteen-minute bursts. Source: [martincid.com](https://www.martincid.com/technology-sv/google-project-suncatcher-tpu-orbit-test/)

**Meta and YouTube will run ads for the Musk documentary: TechCrunch**
Meta and YouTube say they will accept advertising for director Alex Gibney's documentary about Elon Musk. TechCrunch reports the reversal follows earlier reporting that a number of social platforms had rejected the ads. Source: [techcrunch.com](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/26/meta-says-it-will-run-ads-for-musk-documentary-after-all/)

### Company Desk
**Amazon's $3 billion bet on fast deliveries: Financial Times**
The Financial Times headlines Amazon's $3 billion bet on fast deliveries. Local and foreign groups are in a bruising, costly fight to lead that ultra-competitive race. Source: [ft.com](https://www.ft.com/content/09cf09c4-c6e1-4560-a085-f8504bc74f58?syn-25a6b1a6=1)

### The Counterpoint
**Two vibration patents carry the whole damages number: The Verge**
The open question on the Apple award is whether two patents can hold a damages figure of that size. The Verge says the case turned on U.S. Patent Nos. 10,659,885 and 10,820,117, both for vibration-based tactile transducer technology meant to help users feel a signal. That pair, from the 2021 suit, is the record the $5.7 billion number sits on. Source: [theverge.com](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1001118/apple-hit-with-5-7-billion-in-damages-over-haptic-patents)

### The Thread: Who gets to finish the purchase
About $350 million is what Google put into Flipkart in 2024, in a funding round led by Walmart, and that stake now sits under a live checkout test. Google has begun letting shoppers in India buy Walmart-owned Flipkart goods from inside Gemini and AI Mode. A Buy button shows on select Flipkart listings and routes the shopper into a Flipkart checkout without leaving the AI interface. People familiar with the matter, and an experience observed by TechCrunch, put the test with a small group of users and a narrow range of products. The covered goods are smartphones, electronics, and mobile accessories — three categories — while other users still see a standard Flipkart listing with no direct purchase option. Google plans a broader expansion later in October, timed to India's festive shopping season, one of the highest-traffic periods for the country's e-commerce sector. A Google spokesperson told TechCrunch the company is always testing new features so people can discover and connect with businesses more easily. Earlier in 2026 Google introduced the Universal Commerce Protocol, an open standard for agents to move through a retail journey including checkout, and later expanded it so a shopper can transfer items to a retailer's own site. The Flipkart flow observed by TechCrunch is distinct from that Google-hosted checkout: tapping Buy opens a Flipkart-branded payment flow. Google holds the financial stake on top of the technology partnership. GeekWire's live show on Amazon, Meta, and the fight over AI reports Amazon is blocking Meta's Muse assistant from shopping on Amazon.com because the agent does not identify itself. October is Google's expansion date. Amazon's condition is identification. Muse has not met it. Source: [foreignpolicyjournal.com](https://www.foreignpolicyjournal.com/2026/09/27/google-nasdaq-googl-pilots-direct-flipkart-purchases-through-gemini-and-ai-mode-ahead-of-indias-festive-shopping-season/) Source: [geekwire.com](https://www.geekwire.com/2026/live-show-amazon-meta-and-the-fight-over-the-future-of-ai-plus-is-seattle-still-the-place-to-build/)

### On the Calendar
Later in October, Google plans to expand the Flipkart Buy button in Gemini and AI Mode more broadly, timed to India's festive shopping season. Source: [foreignpolicyjournal.com](https://www.foreignpolicyjournal.com/2026/09/27/google-nasdaq-googl-pilots-direct-flipkart-purchases-through-gemini-and-ai-mode-ahead-of-indias-festive-shopping-season/)

# MAG 7 Daily
> **Four Copilot pillars turn Microsoft's work software into an agent layer.**

**What You Need to Know:** Microsoft's largest Copilot update, announced on 25 September, is the same shift: Satya Nadella is pitching Copilot as a new operating system for work, built from Autopilot, Code, Home and Office. Home and Code start through the Frontier programme in the coming weeks. A later private-preview clock covers Autopilot and a new Today view.

### Top News
**Microsoft's largest Copilot update adds Home, Code and Autopilot: Dealroom**
Satya Nadella announced the largest Microsoft Copilot update to date on 25 September 2026 and called Copilot "a new OS for work" spanning every model, form factor and task. Autopilot is a proactive, long-running agent for the enterprise. Code lets people build apps with Copilot hosted inside the company tenant, on the same underlying technology as GitHub Copilot. Home merges Chat and Cowork into one starting point, and Office puts Word, Excel and PowerPoint fully inside Copilot. Copilot can be invoked in Teams. Today is a proactive view that surfaces the most important information across Microsoft 365. Microsoft says Home and Code begin rolling out through its Frontier programme in the coming weeks, Autopilot expands to private preview at the end of September, and Today enters private preview in October, later coming to Outlook and Teams. Source: [app.dealroom.co](https://app.dealroom.co/news/note/microsoft-unveils-its-biggest-copilot-update-home-code-and-autopilot)

**OpenAI asks a court to strike new Apple evidence in a trade-secrets case: 9to5Mac**
OpenAI and the other defendants in Apple's trade-secret misappropriation lawsuit made a new filing. They ask the court to strike two expert declarations and to disregard other evidence Apple recently submitted. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/25/openai-accuses-apple-of-improperly-adding-new-evidence-to-trade-secrets-case/)

**DeepMind researchers leave to build non-LLM startups: Techmeme**
Techmeme points to a Bloomberg look at Google DeepMind researchers who have exited recently. The departures are to launch their own AI startups focused on alternatives to large language models. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/Techmeme/status/2103734016814023124)

### Company Desk
**DeepMind's chief says Gemini 4 should land well before year-end: Trending Topics**
Post-training on Gemini 4 was already in view; what changed is the clock. Koray Kavukcuoglu, head of Google DeepMind, said at The Information's AI Agenda Live Summit that the model should launch "much earlier" than the end of the year, and that Google wants an early version "as soon as possible," then fast improvements, while it is fine-tuned for safety and reliability. Sundar Pichai describes Gemini 4 as a "significantly larger" frontier model focused on coding and autonomous AI agents. In July, DeepMind started what it called its "most ambitious pre-training run yet." Gemini 3.5 Pro, originally announced for I/O in May, never shipped, reportedly because its coding performance fell short. Google instead released cheaper Flash models, Gemini 3.7 Flash in August and Gemini 3.8 Flash in early September. The last true flagship, Gemini 3 Pro, dates to November 2025. TestingCatalog reports Google has been testing Gemini 4 Pro checkpoints under the code name Argon since mid-September; those leaks say a response can run to 256,000 tokens, four times the previous limit, and that the highest reasoning mode took 2.4 to 20 minutes an answer. Source: [trendingtopics.eu](https://www.trendingtopics.eu/gemini-4-rumors-google/)

### The Counterpoint
**The new work OS is being stripped from Windows: Windows Latest**
The lead treats Copilot as a new operating system for work. Windows Latest reports the opposite move on the actual PC operating system: Nadella says "We're building Copilot as a new OS" even as Microsoft strips Copilot from Windows 11. The open question is which surface the agent layer actually lives on once it is no longer a Windows 11 feature. Source: [windowslatest.com](https://www.windowslatest.com/2026/09/26/were-building-copilot-as-a-new-os-says-satya-nadella-even-as-microsoft-strips-it-from-windows-11/)

### The Thread: A twenty-trillion claim and an empty stage
Ars Technica is the dispatch that puts two of the seven in one frame. On Thursday, Tesla's team was in Sparks, Nevada, for a livestreamed, invite-only factory event that officially launched high-volume production of the Semi. The truck in that account is the 500-mile Semi. The concept first rolled onto a Tesla stage in late 2017, and this production start comes nearly a decade later. The room was aimed at a niche: cost-conscious people who manage large trucking fleets. A handful of them, all men, crossed the stage to be thanked for their orders, under a pulsing techno beat. Musk was not there. A pre-taped video played his line: "It's going to be, really, a driver's truck. It's like a sports car in truck form." Ars notes he skipped his second vehicle debut in a row. He was at a White House China State Dinner featuring President Xi Jinping. The company claim that names another of the seven sits beside that absence. Musk has insisted investors think of Tesla as a robotics and autonomous-vehicle company, and he has targeted a $20 trillion valuation, nearly four times the value Ars assigns to Nvidia as market leader. The piece sets a physical limit next to that figure: charging gaps still limit electric trucking as the 500-mile truck moves into volume production. The cross-company fact is not a shared chip order or a joint filing. It is a valuation premise measured against Nvidia, spoken by a chief executive who did not attend his own production launch. Source: [arstechnica.com](https://arstechnica.com/cars/2026/09/teslas-big-electric-truck-faces-an-even-bigger-infrastructure-challenge/)

### On the Calendar
Autopilot expands to private preview at the end of September.
Today enters private preview in October, and later comes to Outlook and Teams. Source: [app.dealroom.co](https://app.dealroom.co/news/note/microsoft-unveils-its-biggest-copilot-update-home-code-and-autopilot)

# MAG 7 Daily
> **Six hundred forty-four million dollars in premiums did not get Tesla Insurance into New York.**

**What You Need to Know:** New York rejected Tesla General Insurance’s plan to cover only Tesla vehicles, after the company’s insurance entities reported $644.2 million in direct written premiums in the first half of 2026. Google is putting Gemini on the phone for ordinary business calls and giving enterprise Gemini Live a lip-synced face. Forty-two state attorneys general are lining up consumer-protection rules for Meta’s chatbots, and a Washington filing lists 277 Microsoft cuts in the Seattle region.

### Top News
**New York blocks Tesla’s VIN-only auto filing: InsuranceNewsNet**
The New York Department of Financial Services rejected a filing from Tesla General Insurance Inc. that would have limited eligibility to Tesla vehicles identified by vehicle identification number. Regulators raised concerns under Section 2324 of New York Insurance Law before reviewing the filing’s actuarial merits, according to an analysis from S&P Global Market Intelligence. Tesla’s insurance entities generated $644.2 million in direct written premiums in the first half of 2026: California $477.8 million, Texas $60.4 million, Nevada $23.3 million, and Maryland $15 million. New York produced no direct written premium in that period even though Tesla Insurance Co. is licensed in the state, S&P said. Source: [insurancenewsnet.com](https://insurancenewsnet.com/innarticle/tesla-insurance-blocked-as-ny-regulators-examine-connected-car-coverage)

**Gemini will place the business call, then stay on the line: Notebookcheck**
Google is rolling out “Call for me” as an early preview on Pixel 11, initially only in the United States, so Gemini handles the conversation rather than only dialing. The support page lists product-availability checks, quote requests, reservations, phone menus, and time on hold. Emergency calls, marketing calls, and payments are excluded, and credit card numbers, passwords, and health information must not be shared. Before the call, the app shows the number and the information Gemini will give or request; Gemini then identifies itself as the user’s AI assistant and says the call is recorded. Users can follow a live transcript, listen in, or take over, and afterward get a summary. Notebookcheck reports that transcripts are stored on Google’s servers, audio stays on the device, and neither is used to train Google’s models. The feature is separate from Agentic Calling, which since 2025 has placed certain business calls from Search or AI Mode rather than free-form tasks in the Gemini app. Source: [notebookcheck.net](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Google-puts-Gemini-on-the-phone-AI-handles-calls-for-questions-and-reservations.1408327.0.html)

**Forty-two states move to police Meta’s chatbots and agents: simplywall.st**
Meta is facing a multistate push in which 42 state attorneys general are coordinating oversight of its AI systems. The coalition aims to enforce safeguards for chatbots and AI agents through state consumer-protection and civil-rights laws. That would extend scrutiny beyond existing federal oversight into state enforcement. Source: [simplywall.st](https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/media/nasdaq-meta/meta-platforms/news/meta-platforms-meta-draws-42-state-push-to-police-ai-chatbot)

**A state filing lists 277 Microsoft cuts in the Seattle region: GeekWire**
A Washington state filing lists 277 positions Microsoft eliminated in the Seattle region, one job title at a time. Art, game production, game design, technical art, and audio design account for 77 of them. Software engineering is the largest single category, at 60. Source: [geekwire.com](https://www.geekwire.com/2026/artists-game-designers-and-producers-hit-hard-as-microsoft-cuts-277-jobs-in-washington-state/)

**Apple and Qualcomm renew a global patent license: 9to5Mac**
Qualcomm and Apple have renewed their global patent licensing agreement. The renewed deal extends a license that had been set to expire in 2027. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/24/apple-and-qualcomm-renew-global-patent-licensing-agreement/)

### Company Desk
**Gemini 3.8 Live grows a face that lip-syncs and keeps talking: Digital Trends**
A week after Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking on September 15, Live Avatar adds near real-time generated video so the agent can lip-sync, use facial expressions, and answer without a freeze between turns. Google is keeping the feature inside Gemini Enterprise for now, for uses such as customer service and interactive walkthroughs, with 97 languages and speech, lip movements, and expressions that adjust without restarting the conversation. Preset avatars are available, and approved enterprise customers can build custom ones from a reference image that preserve likeness, style, or character identity. The avatar can still call tools and fetch information in the background. Generated audio and video carry SynthID watermarking. TechRadar reported that Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking outperformed GPT-Live-1 Astra and Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 across multiple benchmarks while remaining cheaper to run per hour of input audio. Source: [digitaltrends.com](https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-has-given-gemini-3-8-live-a-face-that-can-lip-sync-react-and-use-tools-in-the-background/)

**Golden Gate drops Intel Macs, Boot Camp, and AFP: MacRumors**
macOS Golden Gate is the first macOS that runs only on Apple silicon; Intel Macs cannot run it and stay on macOS Tahoe. Boot Camp Assistant is unsupported. There is no AFP client, Time Capsule no longer works with Golden Gate Macs, and AirPort Utility is no longer included in the install. Upgrading removes Rosetta 2, though it can be reinstalled if an installed app needs it, and Golden Gate is the last macOS with full Rosetta support. A warning appears when a Rosetta app runs, and affected apps are listed under Settings, General, About, Intel-Based Apps. Source: [macrumors.com](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/24/macos-golden-gate-features-removed/)

**Suing lawyers say Meta stamped privilege on too much: The Verge**
In ongoing lawsuits over alleged harm to teens’ safety and mental health, Meta’s lawyers have argued that certain evidence should be withheld as attorney-client privilege. Lawyers suing the company said this week that the label has been applied far too broadly. They pointed to a recently unsealed document, and The Verge reported that employees ordered “attorney/client privilege” hats while those child-safety disclosures were being fought. Source: [theverge.com](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1000370/meta-instagram-attorney-client-privilege-hats)

**Microsoft drops the Copilot Plus PC name: The Verge**
About two and a half years after Microsoft pushed “Copilot Plus PCs” as the machines with enough on-device AI, The Verge reports that Microsoft is killing off the brand. Windows Central’s Zac Bowden is the reporter The Verge cites. The Verge writes that Microsoft and Qualcomm seem to be admitting the brand is already dead. Source: [theverge.com](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1000495/microsoft-is-killing-off-the-copilot-plus-pc-brand)

### The Counterpoint
**The book grew, and it was never built for a broad market: InsuranceNewsNet**
The New York block lands on a business S&P measured as still expanding, and on a product its own analyst says is not a broad-market insurer. Previous S&P research found Tesla generated $1.37 billion in direct written premiums in 2025, up 40.7% from $970.8 million a year earlier. Tesla-affiliated insurers wrote 75.9% of that business directly in 2025, compared with 32.6% in 2024. California remained the largest market, nearly 70% of 2025 premium volume, at $725 million. Tim Zawacki, head of financial institutions research at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said the purpose “is not to be a competitive source of insurance coverage for a broad segment of the market” and is “to essentially eliminate a point of friction in the Tesla sales process.” He said the shift into affiliated carriers emerged partly because some insurers were reluctant to write electric-vehicle business or charged more because of repair costs and loss severity. Source: [insurancenewsnet.com](https://insurancenewsnet.com/innarticle/tesla-insurance-blocked-as-ny-regulators-examine-connected-car-coverage)

### The Thread: Ten billion dollars on a chip still years out
DensityAI, founded a year ago by former leaders of Tesla’s Dojo supercomputer program, is in advanced talks to raise hundreds of millions of dollars in a round that would value it at $10 billion, The Information reported, citing two people with knowledge of the discussions. The valuation is high for a company whose chips those people described as early in development and potentially years from mass production. The company’s leaders have told potential investors they have an agreement in which Amazon Web Services would purchase eventual chips from DensityAI if the chips meet certain performance requirements, the people said. The buy, as those investors were told it, is conditional on performance.

Elon Musk said Colossus 2, an AI computing cluster built by his xAI business, may more than double its current Nvidia chip count by the end of the year, Bloomberg reported. That is a volume target on chips already in the cluster, set against a startup valuation on chips that are still early. They share a calendar. DensityAI’s founders left Tesla’s Dojo effort a year ago and are now describing an Amazon purchase that triggers only if performance requirements are met, while the chips remain years from mass production. Musk’s year-end aim sits on Nvidia parts Colossus 2 already uses, and the scale he named is more than double that current count. For Amazon, the DensityAI clause is optional supply if a new chip qualifies. For Nvidia, Colossus 2 is demand on the parts shipping now. Tesla’s name in the account is the Dojo program those founders left, not the buyer. Source: [theinformation.com](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/startup-founded-ex-tesla-dojo-leaders-nears-10-billion-valuation)

### On the Calendar
In fall 2027, macOS 28 is expected to largely drop Rosetta 2, with an exception for some unmaintained legacy games.
Apple still plans security updates for Intel Macs through fall 2028. Source: [macrumors.com](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/24/macos-golden-gate-features-removed/)

# MAG 7 Daily
> **Hundreds of thousands of merchants can now offer Prime on their own sites at no extra cost.**

**What You Need to Know:** Hundreds of thousands of merchants on Amazon’s U.S. fulfillment network can now turn on fast, free Prime delivery on their own websites at no added cost to them or their shoppers. Google is rolling Gemini audio models out to developers the same day its DeepMind chief says Gemini 4 is in refinement. Apple priced a two-phone number handoff, and Meta put a pocket Muse device and a hundred-gram headset on a launch path.

### Top News
**Merchants switch on Prime delivery on their own sites: About Amazon**
Merchants using Amazon Multichannel Fulfillment in the U.S. can now offer fast, free Prime delivery on their own websites at no additional cost to them or their shoppers. Hundreds of thousands of merchants can activate it in minutes, with no changes to checkout, payments, or store policies. Through the new MCF Preferred Pricing Program, merchants can save up to 25% on fulfillment fees across their own websites, marketplaces, and social channels, with no contracts required. Source: [aboutamazon.com](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-mcf-prime-delivery-merchant-websites?utm_source=rss)

**Gemini Audio models roll out to Studio, Notebook, and the API: Google**
Google said new Gemini Audio models are rolling out across Google AI Studio, Gemini Notebook, and the Gemini API. The linked post is titled around Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech. Google said the models are coming soon to Google Vids and Gemini Enterprise. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/Google/status/2102781492644413566)

**iPhone Handoff gets a monthly price and a short carrier list: MacRumors**
iPhone Handoff in iOS 27 lets the same number sit on two iPhones, active on only one at a time, and it is separate from the existing Handoff that continues an app on another Apple device. Calls, voicemail, messages — including iMessage, RCS, SMS, and MMS — and Find My location move to the phone that is unlocked, with a “Switched to this iPhone” confirmation. T-Mobile in the United States is charging customers 5 per month; Deutsche Telekom is charging €6.95 per month, but only on plans that do not already include multi-SIM, while MagentaMobil L includes one multi-SIM and XL includes two. The feature is available through T-Mobile and Telekom; Verizon and EE will support it later this year, and AT&T has not committed, with a spokesperson pointing to existing eSIM activation and transfer options. Both phones need iOS 27 or later, Wi-Fi, the same Apple Account, Messages in iCloud, and FaceTime and iMessage on that account. Stopping the service means contacting the carrier; deleting an eSIM may not stop the charge. Source: [macrumors.com](https://www.macrumors.com/guide/iphone-handoff-how-it-works-carrier-support-cost/)

**DeepMind chief says Gemini 4 is in refinement: The Verge**
Koray Kavukcuoglu, in his first media appearance as leader of Google’s DeepMind division, told The Information that Gemini 4 is in its refinement stage. The Verge reports Google is nearing the launch after trailing rival developers on flagship AI releases. Source: [theverge.com](https://www.theverge.com/tech/999802/google-deepmind-gemini-4-timeline-koray-kavukcuoglu)

**Apple sets an early-next-week fix for iPhone 18 Pro reboots: 9to5Mac**
Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that a software update is coming early next week for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max phones that freeze and reboot after a failed Face ID attempt. 9to5Mac had reported the failures on Monday and read them as a software glitch rather than a hardware fault. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/23/apple-iphone-18-pro-rebooting-bug-software-update-fix/)

### Company Desk
**Muse stays free and adds Walmart, Sephora, and Best Buy shopping: Benzinga**
After Meta’s test of a human concierge for Muse, Benzinga reports Muse stays free and adds shopping with Walmart, Sephora, and Best Buy. The shopping additions are the new commercial step on the agent. Source: [benzinga.com](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/tech/26/09/61963074/mark-zuckerberg-muse-free-walmart-sephora-best-buy-ai-shopping)

**AI factories come online as Egypt’s institute participation grows: NVIDIA Newsroom**
NVIDIA said AI factories are coming online across Africa, giving developers and startups more local computing. More than 85,000 developers across the continent have trained through the NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute, and participation in Egypt grew more than 10x in one year. NVIDIA pointed to Egypt startups using that talent and infrastructure in Arabic speech, healthcare, robotics, and financial services. Source: [x.com](https://x.com/nvidianewsroom/status/2102714202544611351)

### The Thread: A hundred-gram headset against a shelved pendant
A hundred grams is the weight MacRumors gives Meta’s new VR glasses, five times lighter than the Meta Quest 3, with full-color passthrough and a 5K display. The same report says Apple has shelved plans to launch an AI pendant, while Mark Zuckerberg used a “one more thing” slot at Connect to unveil Muse Charm, a puck about the size of an Apple Watch with a tamagotchi-like avatar for talking to Muse. Zuckerberg said Meta packed the real-time voice and avatar stack into something that fits on a keychain, started by a tap on a fingerprint sensor in the corner, without unlocking a phone or opening an app, and that Charm is aimed at sale by the holiday season, with more to share later this year. The VR glasses are set to launch in the spring at a starting price of 1,300. Meta says they offer cinema-grade clarity with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, up to three hours of continuous high-resolution media playback on a single charge, every game available for Quest headsets, Xbox Cloud Gaming, and a virtual keyboard and trackpad on a desk when connected to a PC or Mac. For context, MacRumors notes an M5 Apple Vision Pro weighs 750–800 grams depending on configuration. An audio-only Ray-Ban model, presented against the “pervert glasses” label, supports media playback and calls and runs for up to 12 hours, while the charging case adds up to 48 hours. The refreshed camera Ray-Ban Meta is slimmer, adds a button that activates Meta AI, and is said to have nine hours of battery versus eight on the second-generation model, plus a six-microphone array Meta says can cut out over 90 percent of background noise. The 12MP camera supports 3K video, with Dolby Atmos spatial audio support coming soon, and prices start at 449. An FDA-cleared hearing enhancement is due later this year, as part of a Meta One subscription or a one-time cost of 149, with a 30-day free trial. Source: [macrumors.com](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/24/meta-did-a-one-more-thing-and-its-an-ai-tamagotchi/)

# MAG 7 Daily
> **U.S. government files brief urging Supreme Court to reverse Apple contempt ruling in Epic case.**

**What You Need to Know:** Apple released the first public betas of iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2 and related updates, adding a redesigned Health app with new tabs and a Health Age metric plus expanded Siri AI language support. Google committed $100 million with the Gates Foundation to scale AI climate and crop tools from 50 million to 200 million smallholder farmers. Microsoft authorized 30-to-50 percent Copilot subscription discounts for large corporate commitments while preparing an AI super app.

### What This Show Covers
Seven companies — Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Tesla — are treated as one desk because together they move the market and share suppliers, regulators and bets. The daily shape is the closes, the news, one thread that runs across several of them, and the calendar. Tesla’s products, self-driving software, energy business and community are covered by the sister show Tesla Shorts Time. Stock picks and portfolio strategy belong to the sister show Modern Investing Techniques. This show never gives advice, never predicts a share price, and every price it speaks is a regular-session close. MAG 7 Daily is part of the Nerra Network, an independent, ad-free network of shows at nerranetwork.com. The network exists to give listeners focused coverage without the noise of broader tech or finance outlets.

### The Tape
Alphabet (GOOGL): closed at $354.97 (+1.6%) on 2026-09-21
Amazon (AMZN): closed at $258.45 (+1.9%) on 2026-09-21
Apple (AAPL): closed at $338.98 (+0.8%) on 2026-09-21
Meta (META): closed at $741.25 (+11.4%) on 2026-09-21

### Top News
**U.S. government urges Supreme Court to reverse Apple contempt ruling over App Store commission:** 9to5Mac
The U.S. government and several legal and business groups filed briefs with the Supreme Court urging reversal of at least part of the civil contempt ruling against Apple in the Epic Games lawsuit. The district court held Apple in contempt after the company allowed external purchase links yet imposed a 27 percent commission on those transactions. Apple has since removed the commission entirely. The company maintains that the original injunction text did not prohibit charging a commission and that lower courts improperly relied on the spirit of the order rather than its wording. The injunction states that Apple is permanently restrained from prohibiting developers from including buttons, external links or other calls to action that direct customers to purchasing mechanisms outside In-App Purchasing. The Supreme Court agreed in late June to hear Apple’s argument on this point. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/22/u-s-government-urges-supreme-court-to-reverse-apple-contempt-ruling-over-app-store-commission/)

**Google and the Gates Foundation to bring AI resources to 200 million farmers across the Global South.:** Google Blog
Google partnered with the Gates Foundation to direct $100 million toward organizations that scale AI-powered climate and crop insights. The program targets 200 million smallholder farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia, an increase from the current 50 million reached. Smallholder farmers produce nearly 35 percent of the world’s food across more than 500 million farms yet often lack access to satellite data, financial services and public support needed for unpredictable weather. The combined funding includes dedicated technical support from Google researchers to deploy real-time climate, agricultural and language AI tools. Source: [blog.google](https://blog.google/company-news/outreach-and-initiatives/google-org/partnering-with-the-gates-foundation-to-bring-ai-resources-to-200-million-farmers-across-the-global-south/)

**Microsoft to Boost Copilot Discounts as It Launches AI ‘Super App’:** The Information
Microsoft leaders told sales staff this week that the company is authorizing 30-to-50 percent discounts on Copilot AI software subscriptions for corporate customers who commit to large numbers of seats and agree to additional payments based on usage of certain features. The steeper discounts apply when customers commit to specific feature usage levels. The company is simultaneously preparing an AI super app for launch. Source: [theinformation.com](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/exclusive-microsoft-boost-copilot-discounts-launches-ai-super-app)

**Apple expands Tap to Pay on iPhone across eight Latin American markets:** 9to5Mac
Apple expanded Tap to Pay on iPhone to eight additional Latin American countries supported by six regional payment platforms. The feature lets merchants accept contactless payments directly on iPhone without extra hardware. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/22/apple-expands-tap-to-pay-on-iphone-across-eight-latin-american-markets/)

### Company Desk
**Alphabet (GOOGL):** Google Blog
Google partnered with the Gates Foundation on the $100 million AI farming initiative described in Top News. The effort supplies real-time climate, agricultural and language AI tools to organizations serving smallholder farmers.

**Amazon (AMZN):** Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Amazon introduced CloudWatch Omni, an AI-powered observability service for generative AI and agentic workloads. The service supports collaborative monitoring of applications and is designed for teams working with generative AI and agentic systems. Source: [aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/introducing-amazon-cloudwatch-omni-ai-powered-observability-for-generative-ai-and-agentic-workloads/)

**Apple (AAPL):** 9to5Mac
Apple seeded the first public betas of iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, tvOS 27.2 and watchOS 27.2. The updates include a redesigned Health app featuring Insights and Longevity tabs along with a Health Age feature that compares fitness metrics to chronological age. New profile options appear in the Apple TV app. Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish in addition to English. The builds match the second developer betas released the previous day. Source: [9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/22/apple-releases-first-ios-27-2-public-beta-with-new-iphone-health-app/)

**Meta (META):** Reuters
Meta is testing a human concierge service for its new personal AI agent, Muse. Source: [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/business/meta-testing-human-concierge-its-new-personal-ai-agent-muse-2026-09-22/)

**Microsoft (MSFT):** The Information

### The Counterpoint
**Wall Street’s GPU Futures Push Stalls at the CFTC:** The Information
The Commodity Futures Trading Commission extended its review of proposed futures contracts on Nvidia GPU rental prices, delaying any launch past the targeted early October date and requiring broader industry comments on how the contracts would function. Source: [theinformation.com](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/wall-streets-gpu-futures-push-stalls-cftc)

### The Thread: AI tool launches and partnerships
Google and the Gates Foundation are directing $100 million to scale AI climate and crop tools that already reach 50 million smallholder farmers and will expand to 200 million across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Those farmers produce nearly 35 percent of global food on more than 500 million farms. Microsoft is simultaneously authorizing 30-to-50 percent discounts on Copilot subscriptions tied to large seat commitments and usage-based payments while preparing an AI super app. Amazon introduced CloudWatch Omni, an AI-powered observability service built for generative AI and agentic workloads that enables collaborative monitoring across teams. Meta is testing a human concierge layer for its Muse personal AI agent to handle complex user requests. These moves show the companies layering new AI services onto existing platforms while attaching concrete funding, discount and reach numbers to the rollouts. The Google-Gates partnership adds dedicated technical support from Google researchers for real-time tools. Microsoft’s discount structure requires customers to commit to additional payments based on usage of certain features. Amazon’s service targets workloads that involve generative AI agents. Meta’s concierge test focuses on its newest agent product. The combined activity illustrates parallel efforts to extend AI capabilities with measurable scale targets and pricing adjustments.
